summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (loader plus _resolve_path helper, using only os and json), an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with an autofunction entry in docs/source/data.rst after the Utilities automodule, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist covering the four specified cases. Nothing was run, per instructions; line lengths were checked by hand (one test line was split to stay under 120 columns). Choices: non-list key values and non-object top-level JSON raise ValueError; malformed JSON propagates as json.JSONDecodeError (a ValueError subclass); items are copied, not mutated. Nothing was committed.
